name: Super State

abilities.text: Enchanted creature has base power and toughness 9/9 and has flying, first strike, trample, and haste.
Whenever enchanted creature deals combat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage to each other opponent.

notes: The 'Enchant creature you control' line is claimed by the aura static that carries the enchant restriction; the base 9/9 and the keywords are the set-pt static (layer 7b, CR 613.4b), which is why the keyword grant appears on both. APPROXIMATION: 'each other opponent' is written as each-opponent (there is no 'every opponent but that one' target), so the damaged opponent takes the damage twice; and the damage is dealt by the Aura rather than by the enchanted creature.
